info.name: ONS — Run once: setup, workflows and security
info.description: Import ONS_Local.postman_environment.json, select it, fill adminPassword, testEmail and testPhone. Run this collection with ONE iteration, in the saved order. The flow creates its own campaigns, staff and fixtures. There is NO need to create employee accounts manually. All requests disable the cookie jar; payment requests send captured registration cookies explicitly. Main run tests PENDING payment flow; hosted PAID checkout and 7-minute/15-minute age tests are optional. Requests marked optional are skipped unless their environment flag is true. Runs generate real test records, invoices and notifications through configured integrations. See README.md for dependencies, limits, and cleanup. No requests were executed by the assistant.

item.name: 15 — Optional PAID invoice verification after checkout
item.description: Hosted Moyasar card entry/3DS is not automated. Open environment paymentUrlA in your browser and complete a TEST payment first. Then set runPaidVerification=true and run this folder. Registration session must still be valid (30 minutes of inactivity); a session check failure is 403. Do not rerun the entire collection to verify an old invoice because step 00 creates a new run. First successful paid verification sends the invoice email; repeat verification should not resend it.

item.name: 16 — Automatic anonymous security matrix, including aliases
item.description: One rejection test for every protected path/method mapping from the current controllers. Uses no credentials, no cookie jar and sentinel IDs to avoid deleting real fixtures if a rule is missing. Report /report aliases are included. Public endpoints are covered by the earlier functional flow; the public legacy self-service alias is checked with invalid data to avoid an extra email/report.
